entries.meal: Honey Chili Crisp Chicken Thighs with Pineapple Salsa
entries.notes: Bake thighs on a sheet pan, 18 min at 190C/385F. Salsa stored in its own container all week, added fresh to each bowl rather than baked in. Estimated ~528 cal / 44g protein per container — fits the 600-cal dinner target well.

entries.meal: Extra batch: beef meatballs + creamy cabbage chicken breast with fettuccine
ingredients: ground beef (extra, buy more), breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, parsley, salt + pepper, carrot, celery, garlic, onion, tomato sauce, basil (meatballs)
chicken breast (sliced through the middle), boiled cabbage, cream cheese, black pepper + salt, parmesan, 2-3 cloves garlic
entries.notes: Not portioned into individual containers — combined into one large container as occasional extra food, not tracked against daily macro targets.

Fridge up to 3 days / freezer 4 months. Estimated ~900 cal per container, ~300 over the 600-cal dinner target — mostly from the peanut oil, sesame oil, and brown sugar. Try halving the peanut oil (~15ml) and brown sugar (~40g) next time to bring it closer to target.
